interpretation.units: Recall, Macro-F1 and balanced accuracy are fractions; differences marked pp are percentage points
interpretation.aggregation: Arithmetic mean and sample standard deviation across seeds; exact seed-paired differences; no pooled confusion matrices
interpretation.partial: Partial summaries explicitly retain n, complete and missing seed values; no final verdict before complete coverage
interpretation.selection: G1 fixed CIL method chosen by five-seed mean per dataset/metric/budget; G2 is a per-class envelope, not one classifier
interpretation.joint: Original Section21 eight-epoch Joint is reused unchanged, not a universal empirical upper bound
interpretation.decision: Five separate ratios of five-seed Replay mean recall to original Joint mean recall at S=2000; A all >=0.5, B all <0.2; mixed is intermediate
interpretation.threshold_precision: Numerical equality at a ratio threshold uses 1e-12 absolute/relative tolerance; this preserves the inclusive 0.5 and exclusive 0.2 boundaries
interpretation.zero_joint: A zero Joint denominator yields null, never infinity or a qualifying ratio
interpretation.runtime: Original sources may mix HPC/local software and hardware; timings are not hardware-matched comparisons
interpretation.research_scope: Section22 is a training-protocol diagnostic under RQ2/RO2, not a mechanism, innovation claim, or overall research completion

section22_3.reason: Replay reaches at least 50% of Joint mean recall for every named class

analysis_provenance.seed_note: Deterministic paired descriptive aggregation; no random sampling
